notes.title: Demo of «Amnea28» is out!
notes.notes:
We've been working hard for a long time, and finally the demo of «Amnea28» is out on Steam! 

«Amnea28» is a novel we created in 2022, before «Graces», but it just so happened that it's only being released on this platform now. It's much bigger than «Graces», so we'd like to believe that the stay in the old hotel will be to your liking and you'll be able to solve all its mysteries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/9ebb05dc4609abc370b7bba54336abf0e38006ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/d9cce44a4a8b50331365b7fee8a8ae42073a925a.png[/img]

∞ "Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 

∞ Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/aa131bce0ef808276a0073513c35566f9ada4ff1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/d54170beaffb5c45060e85173f3a6bd5148294fc.png[/img]

∞ About 1.5-2 hours of the story's prologue

∞ The introduction of the protagonist and 4 main characters, as well as the cameos of 4 side characters (the protagonist can't romance anyone; however there are certain romantic subplots in the story)

∞ 11 CGs, 6 extra arts and atmospheric soundtrack
